title: qos_auto_weights_after duplicates qos_auto_weights (~40 lines) and its guard use is a structurally dead check
detail: Two near-identical ladder walks (in-play scan + never-drop fold + row hand-out) must now stay in sync; and since the candidate lane always gets a ≥1 ladder share, the after-branch check is dead code — 40 duplicated lines compute a constant.
recommended_fix: Factor the shared in-play scan + fold + ladder walk into one internal helper both procs call; or replace the after-branch with an explicit skip for auto pipes plus a comment citing the loader's ≥1 ladder validation.

title: E6 guard's auto-pipe heuristic (weights==auto) diverges from the app's editor-open manual mode — never-drop zero-lane window
detail: Core predicts auto-follow from weights==auto; the app also suppresses it when the editor is open. Keyboard lane keys reach that window: a never-drop class can land on a zero-weight lane, backstopped only by the flow floor. Pre-diff, the bus rejected this edit.
recommended_fix: Mirror the panel cycle's zeroed-lane skip (qos_panel.odin:118) in the keyboard path, or run the auto-follow whenever weights already equal the ladder result even with the editor open — making the guard's prediction true.

title: Demos hardcode app-mirroring ladder splits; a playtest ladder re-tune silently desyncs demos from app behavior
evidence:
demos/sla.dem:25:
at 100ms weights 0 50 30 20
demos/qos_contention.dem:22:
at 100ms weights 0 50 30 20
demos/audio_throttle.dem:19-20:
at 200ms weights 0 70 30 0
at 200ms weights 1 70 30 0
data/balance.json (_comment): "...Playtest-tunable; load-fail-fast validated (ODN-5)...."
detail: The 'app-mirroring' demo weights restate ladder values that balance.json owns (ODN-5). A playtest ladder re-tune silently desyncs demos from app behavior — goldens keep blessing the stale splits with no failure.
recommended_fix: Add a harness directive emitting the ladder result (e.g. weights-auto <pipe>, lowering to qos_auto_weights over the lane intents) and swap the hardcoded splits for it.
